Q: Oracle pl sql and Java A:

Keywords: DAO, JPA, Hibernate.

You can find several helpful tutorials on YouTube, such as 'Building and Deploying Spring Boot Applications with PostgreSQL.'

Additionally, I recommend searching for the keywords 'Spring Boot PostgreSQL CRUD' on Stack Overflow.

Q: Microsoft Visual C++ 2022 X86 Minimum Runtime Error (Redlist14, specifically vc_runtimeMinimum_x86.msi) During Installation A:

Looks like that your computer is missing a required component of the Microsoft Visual C++ runtime library. For this issue, here are some suggestions to troubleshoot:

  1. Download, run this tool, select Uninstalling, try to uninstall following runtimes.
Microsoft Visual C++ xxxx Xxx Additional Runtime – xx.xx.xxxxx

Microsoft Visual C++ xxxx Xxx Debug Runtime – xx.xx.xxxxx

Microsoft Visual C++ xxxx Xxx Minimum Runtime – xx.xx.xxxxx

  1. Download and reinstall the Visual C++ Redistributable package from here.

  2. Run Visual Studio Installer as administrator and try to repair your VS.

  3. If not work, you can also collect setup log files generated during installation and then search detailed error messages to analyze the cause of the issue.

    (1) download Microsoft Visual Studio and .NET Framework log collection tool https://aka.ms/vscollect

    (2) run Collect.exe in an administrative command prompt The tool generates a vslogs.zip file in your %TEMP% folder, typically at C:\Users\YourName\AppData\Local\Temp\vslogs.zip.

    For more information, please refer to: Troubleshoot installation or upgrades - Visual Studio (Windows)

Q: JSON data in Web_custom_request- Vugen A:

See these two lines:

request_json_base=  "{\"GLDefaultId\":0,\"ProjectId\":{ContactProjectId},\"CoaMainId\":10,\"UserId\":{UserId},\"Notes\":\"\",\"PRO_GLDefaultValue\":[{\"GLDefaultValueId\":0,\"GLDefaultId\":0,\"SegmentId\":16,\"Alias\":\"ACT\",\"SegmentType\":\"DETAIL\",\"FunctionTypeId\":0,\"Value\":\"&&&\",\"Mask\":\"&&&\",\"IsRequired\":true,\"LastModified\":null,\"IsCoaRequired\":true},{\"GLDefaultValueId\":0,\"GLDefaultId\":0,\"SegmentId\":17,\"Alias\":\"ST\",\"SegmentType\":\"SET\",\"FunctionTypeId\":0,\"Value\":\"&&\",\"Mask\":\"&&\",\"IsRequired\":false,\"LastModified\":null,\"IsCoaRequired\":false}]}",

request_json = lr_eval_string(request_json_base);

They are not doing what you think they are doing. You are neither allocating space for this data ( see malloc() in combination with a char * variable), nor are you assigning the value to the variable correctly for the C language (see strcpy() )

How to correctly assign a new string value?

Q: Python: attempting to open serial caused IOError: [Errno 6] Device not configured A:

I had similar problem and I fixed it with the following solution

$ sudo nano /etc/inittab

and go to the bottom of the file, you will see

T0:23:respawn:/sbin/getty -L ttyAMA0 115200 vt100

or similar

simply add a # character to the beginning,now it looks like:

 #T0:23:respawn:/sbin/getty -L ttyAMA0 115200 vt100

save the file and reboot

Reference: http://www.hobbytronics.co.uk/raspberry-pi-serial-port
